name: sol-advisor
description: Quality-first Codex workflow with global route evaluation, project opt-out, bounded functional subagents, isolated primary context, and weighted quota routing.

interface.shortDescription: Quality-first delegation for context and quota efficiency.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor evaluates bounded delegation globally unless a project opts out, and routes six functional custom agents only when delegation preserves task accuracy and completion while improving primary-context isolation, weighted quota cost, or independent verification. Spark handles eligible light scouting and small deterministic edits; GPT-5.6 roles handle investigation, synthesis, large mechanical edits, risk-selected verification, and genuine adjudication. The primary session owns design-dependent implementation, bounded evidence checks, fallback, and final integration.
defaultPrompt: Preserve task accuracy and completion before considering delegation.
Delegate only when a bounded role improves primary-context isolation, weighted quota cost, or independent verification.
Keep design-dependent implementation primary; read one native final result, allow one targeted correction with the same model and effort, then fall back.
